announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares seeks early refinancing of the outstanding Bond 2023/2027 by increasing the Bond 2024/2029 by up to EUR 165 million
announcements.insight: Mutares seeks early refinancing of its Bond 2023/2027 by increasing the Bond 2024/2029. This follows recent portfolio disposals aimed at transformation.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares advances growth and portfolio transformation in the first nine months of 2026: record acquisition, dynamic exit activity with strong outlook and guidance confirmed
announcements.insight: Mutares confirms strong exit activity following earlier SRT Group sales in November. The announcement highlights record acquisition and dynamic portfolio transformation for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has signed an agreement for the sale of Guascor Energy to Oaktree
announcements.insight: Mutares has signed a sale agreement for Guascor Energy to Oaktree. This follows recent disposals of SRT Group and Natura sp. z o.o., indicating an ongoing portfolio reduction.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares signs agreement to sell the Magirus Firefighter Business Unit to Morita Holdings Corporation – Defense business is retained
announcements.insight: Mutares disposes of its Magirus Firefighter Business Unit to Morita Holdings Corporation while retaining its defense business. This follows recent completions of acquisitions and sales within its portfolio.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has sold SRT Group and its subsidiaries to Quiver
announcements.insight: Mutares has completed the sale of SRT Group following an irrevocable offer received in October. This disposal marks a key step in executing its portfolio strategy.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares portfolio company Efacec is a critical enabler of the global electrification supercycle; order backlog of more than EUR 1.0 billion; strategic exit options under review.
announcements.insight: Strategic exit options for Efacec are under review. This follows recent acquisitions and sales, indicating active portfolio management by Mutares.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares receives an irrevocable offer for the acquisition of SRT Group and its subsidiaries from Quiver
announcements.insight: Mutares receives an irrevocable offer for SRT Group, following earlier acquisitions in October. Shareholders should monitor developments regarding this potential strategic expansion.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has signed a term sheet for the sale of Natura sp. z o.o. to Grupa Specjał
announcements.insight: Mutares has signed a term sheet to sell Natura sp. z o.o. to Grupa Specjał, marking a portfolio disposal following its recent acquisitions of Synthomer and Steinmüller Engineering.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares completes the acquisition of long-established Steinmüller Engineering GmbH from IHI Group
announcements.insight: Mutares completes the acquisition of Steinmüller Engineering GmbH. This follows the September agreement to acquire the business from IHI Group.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares portfolio company Nord Gas Solutions benefits from a booming market; 2026 revenue expected to exceed EUR 575m, with record order backlog of EUR 880m; strategic exit options under review.
announcements.insight: Strategic exit options for Nord Gas Solutions are under review. This follows recent acquisitions of Synthomer and Steinmüller Engineer, indicating portfolio consolidation.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares receives irrevocable offer for the acquisition of a controlling stake in Lapeyre Group from an investment vehicle backed by Italian entrepreneurs
announcements.insight: Mutares receives an irrevocable offer for a controlling stake in Lapeyre Group. This follows recent acquisitions and disposals, indicating continued portfolio activity.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares announces results of partial repurchase offer for outstanding Nordic Bond 2023/2027
announcements.insight: Mutares announces results of its partial repurchase offer for outstanding Nordic Bond 2023/2027, following the offer announcement in September. This confirms the outcome of the debt instrument buyback.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares completes the acquisition of Synthomer a.s. from Synthomer plc to grow further the Chemicals & Materials segment
announcements.insight: Mutares completes acquisition of Synthomer a.s., expanding its Chemicals & Materials segment. This follows recent disposals and a signed agreement for Steinmüller Engineer.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has signed an agreement to acquire long-established Steinmüller Engineering GmbH from IHI Group
announcements.insight: Mutares acquires Steinmüller Engineering GmbH. This follows recent disposals of NEM Energy, Cimos and Prénatal Netherlands, indicating a portfolio shift.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares announces partial buyback offer for outstanding Nordic Bond 2023/2027
announcements.insight: Mutares announces a partial buyback for its Nordic Bond. This follows recent disposals of NEM Energy, Cimos and Prénatal Netherlands.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has sold Prénatal Netherlands to its CEO Jochem van Bueren
announcements.insight: Mutares continues its portfolio optimization by selling Prénatal Netherlands to management. This follows recent disposals of NEM Energy and Cimos.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has sold Cimos to the company’s management supported by investor Vero Automotive
announcements.insight: Mutares continues its portfolio optimization by selling Cimos to management backed by Vero Automotive. This follows earlier disposals of Walor Precision Turning and NEM Energy Group.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has completed the sale of NEM Energy Group to Hyundai Heavy Industries Power Systems (“HPS”)
announcements.insight: Mutares completes another disposal, following sales in July. This continues its portfolio activity alongside recent acquisitions announced in August.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has completed the acquisition of Magna’s Car Top Systems Business
announcements.insight: Mutares completes acquisition of Magna’s Car Top Systems Business. This follows earlier disposals in July and a prior August acquisition, indicating active portfolio management.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares grows and generates Group revenues of EUR 3.4 billion in the first half of 2026 – further exit activities expected in the second half, guidance for fiscal year 2026 confirmed
announcements.insight: Mutares confirms FY2026 guidance while reporting EUR 3.4bn H1 revenue. This follows recent disposals to Invex and Reed Capital, indicating continued portfolio optimization.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares completes landmark acquisition of the Engineering Thermoplastics Business in the Americas and Europe from SABIC
announcements.insight: Mutares completes a landmark acquisition of engineering thermoplastics. This follows recent portfolio disposals to Redo Oy and Walor Precision Turning.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has sold Walor Precision Turning to Reed Capital
announcements.insight: Mutares has sold Walor Precision Turning to Reed Capital. This follows previous disposals of Redo Oy and acquisitions like Synthomer a.s., indicating continued portfolio management.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has sold Redo Oy to Invex Group
announcements.insight: Mutares has completed the disposal of Redo Oy to Invex Group. This follows recent portfolio activity including the acquisition of Synthomer and sale of NEM Energy.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA: Annual General Meeting approves dividend of EUR 2.00 per share – successful capital increase, strong exit momentum and international expansion characterized the first half of 20
announcements.insight: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA AGM approved a EUR 2.00 per share dividend, following its successful capital increase and portfolio activity in June.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares portfolio company Amaneos completes acquisition of European Automotive Lighting Business from Magna as strategic add-on for LMS
announcements.insight: Portfolio company Amaneos completes an acquisition. This follows Mutares' recent activity including a sale to Hyundai and an agreement to acquire Synthomer.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Bafin completes audit of the Financial Statements 2023
announcements.insight: BaFin completed its audit of Mutares' 2023 financial statements. This regulatory milestone follows recent portfolio transactions including the sale of Walor Precision Turning and NEM Energy Group.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has signed an agreement to acquire Synthomer a.s. from Synthomer plc to grow further the Chemicals & Materials segment
announcements.insight: Mutares acquires Synthomer a.s. to expand its Chemicals & Materials segment, following recent disposals of NEM Energy Group and Walor Precision Turning.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has signed an agreement to sell NEM Energy Group to Hyundai Heavy Industries Power Systems (“HPS”)
announcements.insight: Mutares has signed an agreement to sell NEM Energy Group. This follows earlier announcements regarding acquisitions and tender offers in June 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: Mutares has signed an agreement to sell NEM Energy Group to Hyundai Heavy Industries Power Systems (“HPS”)
announcements.insight: Mutares disposes of NEM Energy Group to Hyundai Heavy Industries Power Systems. This follows recent acquisitions and tender offers, indicating active portfolio management.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares portfolio company F.lli Ferrari Holding completes partial sale of its Benelux operations to HMF Group
announcements.insight: Mutares portfolio company F.lli Ferrari Holding completes a partial sale of Benelux operations to HMF Group. This follows the May agreement and aligns with Mutares' active M&A strategy seen in recent acquisitions.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares receives an irrevocable offer to sell Walor Precision Turning from Reed Capital
announcements.insight: Mutares receives an irrevocable offer to sell Walor Precision Turning from Reed Capital. This follows a series of recent acquisitions and disposals, indicating ongoing portfolio management.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA: Announcement of the results of the public tender offer for the outstanding Nordic Bond 2023/2027
announcements.insight: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA announces results of a public tender offer for its outstanding Nordic Bond 2023/2027. This follows recent portfolio acquisitions and operational updates.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has signed an agreement to acquire TREPEL Airport Equipment GmbH and MAFI Transport‑Systeme GmbH from NDW Maschinenbau Holding GmbH
announcements.insight: Mutares continues its acquisition strategy with this latest purchase, following completed deals in May and June. This expands its portfolio but adds to execution risk.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares has completed the acquisition of the Gas Solutions business from Wärtsilä
announcements.insight: Mutares has completed an acquisition of a business unit. This follows earlier portfolio updates in May 2026, indicating continued expansion activity.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Mutares portfolio company F.lli Ferrari Holding has signed an agreement for the partial sale of its Benelux operations to HMF Group
announcements.insight: Mutares' portfolio company F.lli Ferrari Holding signed an agreement for the partial sale of its Benelux operations to HMF Group.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Magirus starts 2026 with strong momentum in Q1, record high order intake; Mutares initiates preparation of exit process
announcements.insight: Mutares initiates an exit process for Magirus, signaling a potential sale. This strategic move may unlock value for shareholders through a formal disposal.
